code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Repeat the block above the all-zero divider below it.
    div=next((i for i,row in enumerate(g) if all(v==0 for v in row)),None)
    if div is not None:
        h=div

            g[r]=g[(r-(div+1))%h][:]
    return g
